system.description:
Named Unique (trident +2). You breathe water and swim at full speed. Once per day, sweep it: creatures in a 15ft cone make a Reflex save (Str DC) or are pushed 10ft and knocked Prone.

Quirk (Homesick): a day away from the sea, its power sleeps until it touches salt water. Dragged from the wreck-strewn shallows of Freeport Bay; sailors swear the sea gave it up as a tithe.

Monsters & Treasure, Named Uniques. Saves use DC 10 + half your level + the attribute named.
